meta.note: Sample set of automatic pictures (O3) for Chem Sketcher and App Maker to scan. Drawn by tools/make-pictures.py from the SMILES; width/height are written by the tool. Not yet checked: see art/organic1/REVIEW.md.

pictures.alt: Bond-line structure of butane: a zigzag of four carbons in a row.
Bond-line structure of 2-methylbutane: a four-carbon zigzag with a one-carbon branch on the second carbon.
Bond-line structure of cyclohexane: a plain six-membered ring of single bonds.
Bond-line structure of ethanol: a two-carbon chain ending in an OH group.
Bond-line structure of benzene: a six-membered ring with alternating double bonds.
Bond-line structure of (E)-but-2-ene: a central double bond with the two methyl groups on opposite sides.
Bond-line structure of (Z)-but-2-ene: a central double bond with the two methyl groups on the same side.
Bond-line structure of (R)-2-bromobutane: a four-carbon chain with a bromine on carbon 2; one bond at carbon 2 is drawn as a wedge or dash to show its configuration.
Bond-line structure of trans-1,2-dimethylcyclohexane: a six-membered ring with two neighbouring methyl groups, one on a wedge bond and one on a dash bond.
Bond-line structure of the acetate ion: a methyl group on a carbon with one double-bonded oxygen and one oxygen carrying a negative charge.
